blocks.text: SALT LAKE CITY— Devin Booker had 23 points and the Phoenix Suns scored the final six of the game to pull away late and beat the Utah Jazz 111-101 in an NBA Cup matchup Friday night. With the Suns clinging to a four-point lead in the final minute, Booker made a basket and a free throw and Jalen Green added a dunk and another free throw to clinch Phoenix’s fifth victory in six games.
